about: Shared Neuryo mannequin head. Mesh: MakeHuman 1.x base mesh (CC0 1.0): head, ears, eyes, neck and shoulders, smoothed once then cut flat. Scaled to a 540 mm head circumference (mid-point of Indian adult male 548 mm and female 532 mm means, Neuryo-Research P190). Units mm; y up, face +z, wearer's left +x; origin at the head centre used for az/el. Built by tools/ (see docs/head.md).
method: 10-10 sites measured on the skull surface (ears masked out): nasion-inion midline arc in 10% steps; preauricular-Cz-preauricular arc for T7/T8; Fpz-T7-Oz circumference in 10% steps; each lateral row (AF, F, FC, C, CP, P, PO) as an arc from its left circumference point through its midline point to the right one, in equal steps; Nz-preauricular-Iz ring for the 9/10 row. Inion is not visible on this smooth mannequin and is taken on the back midline at nasion height + 5 mm.

extra_notes.TP9_clear: TP9 moved 15 mm back along its ring so a 9 mm pad clears this mannequin's ear.
extra_notes.EOG_L: About 20 mm below the centre of the left eye (vertical EOG).
extra_notes.EOG_R: About 20 mm below the centre of the right eye.

lobe.note: Left earlobe centre and the ear-plane normal (points outward).

field.about: Skull radius from the origin every 1 degree, ears masked and filled. Read with bicubic interpolation.

brow_note: Height (y) of the eyebrow line, about 16 mm above the eye centres. Head-worn parts keep their lower edge above it.
